answer: Independent-set jury drafting: build a suspicion graph where each account is a vertex and an edge joins any pair sharing a funding root, a timing cluster or a jade-hashed IP prefix. Each epoch the node draws grading panels only as independent sets of that graph (beacon-seeded greedy coloring) and never seats a vertex to grade a neighbor. A clone ring that coordinates by whisper can then never review its own answers or share a panel, so mutual rubber-stamping earns nothing and mixed panels expose its outliers.
